interface.longDescription: Create and manage YouTube thumbnails through YouThumb MCP or REST. Use 33 tools, persisted personal bucket UUIDs with explicit historical indexing, reliable person/text prompts, absolute template URLs, face associations and compact paginated results. Keep one project per thumbnail.
